# Chapter One

Mara had grey eyes and a habit of counting doors. The mill on the Harrow road was the first building she had ever loved, and the Harrow road is the old road to the coast, closed since the flood of 1898.

Teodor arrived at noon, as he always did. He called the ledger the Book of Hours, though it recorded flour, and he had kept it for eleven years.

She told him the story about the bees: how her grandmother had sold honey in pickle jars, the labels in her own hand, and had never written anything else down.
